GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 123 (21 Dec 45) ESS/FI
(SCAPIN - 470)
APO 500
21 December 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : Imperial Japanese Government
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo
SUBJECT : Currencies and Financial Instruments of Japanese Repatriates
1. Reference is made to C.L.O. Memorandum No. 823 (5.1), dated 1 December 1945, subject: "Inspection of Currencies, Securities, etc. brought in by Japanese Repatriates," requesting permission for Japanese repatriates to bring with them from ports of embarkation, currencies, securities and financial instruments.
2. This request is disapproved.
3. This Headquarters is taking such action as is deemed necessary with respect to the uniform handling of currencies and financial instruments of Japanese repatriates.
4. An acknowledgement of the receipt of this memorandum is directed.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
/s/ H. W. Allen
/t/ H. W. ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst. Adjutant General
